title: Woman's family joked about her looking 'nothing' like her siblings, then a DNA test revealed something even more shocking
summary_full: A family joke about adoption unexpectedly became reality for Payton Lee after a DNA test.  The test revealed she shared a different father than her four younger siblings.  This discovery meant the man she knew as Dad for twenty-nine years was not her biological father.  Her father reacted with understanding, stating their relationship remained unchanged.  Payton now advises caution when taking home DNA tests for casual fun.
